description: What the engine plugin synced into the game: when the last sync was, the scenes waiting in the Inbox (not in any tab yet; each has a suggested tab from its project path) and the scenes that are already entities, with their folder. Call it after the user clicks Sync in the plugin, to confirm it worked, and before creating entities by hand for a Godot game: a synced scene must not be created twice. Inbox not empty: place them with place_scenes. Plugin flow, in order: sync_scenes (the plugin sends its scenes), game_scenes (see what arrived), place_scenes (turn them into entities), mark_installed (the plugin reports the install).

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

name: game_scenes
title: Scenes the engine sent
